szoveg_eredeti:
SAN FRANCISCO, CA — November 18, 2026 Ahead of Anthropic’s upcoming initial public offering, the Center for AI Safety (CAIS) today joined a rare coalition of prominent figures in signing the MisAnthropic Statement.

The statement challenges the disconnect between Anthropic’s public “safety” branding and its reckless attempt to build recursively self-improving AI and consolidate power. Published today at misanthropicstatement.com, the statement reads:

The coalition brings together AI safety researchers, open-source advocates, AI ethicists, and accelerationists – united by a shared rejection of Anthropic’s effort to position itself to the public and policymakers as the industry’s “good guys.”

“People in this coalition disagree on almost everything, yet we all recognize the danger of a company that convinces itself its own dominance is the greater good,” said Dan Hendrycks, Executive Director of the Center for AI Safety. “You cannot credibly claim to be safe while weakening your own previous safety commitments and asking the public for tens of billions of dollars to build recursively self-improving AI.”

The full statement and complete list of signatories can be viewed at misanthropicstatement.com.

About the Center for AI Safety: The Center for AI Safety (CAIS) is a San Francisco-based research and advocacy nonprofit dedicated to reducing societal-scale risks from advanced artificial intelligence. Through technical research, policy development, and public engagement, CAIS works to ensure AI is developed safely and remains under human control. Learn more at safe.ai.
